messages:
maya: Quick design review — two layout options for Usage > Billing header. Option A: compact legend stacked under chart, invoice CTA inline to right. Option B: inline legend to the right of chart, invoice link under the date selector. Thoughts?

sam: I prefer B for visual scanning. Right-side legend reduces vertical scroll, looks cleaner.

aj: Implementation note: right-side legend is simpler with flex/grid, but small screens will cram it. Stacked feels safer for mobile.

leo: Accessibility: if legend is placed to the right visually, DOM order must still be logical. Screen readers should read chart summary then legend. Also keyboard focus order needs testing.

sam: We can keep DOM order [chart, legend] and use CSS grid to put legend on the right. That keeps SR order consistent.

aj: Agreed. Rough CSS we can use: 
```
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 240px; gap: 16px; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
```
This avoids layout thrash.

olivia: From support calls, customers often ask "where's my invoice" after viewing spend. Putting a clear invoice CTA near the cost summary helps reduce tickets.

maya: Good point. Proposal: primary small CTA near the cost summary (right above chart) + a secondary link in the header for quick access. Keeps discoverability without cluttering the chart area.

sam: Also, token legend colors — current palette has low contrast for the purple/blue pair at small sizes. I'll iterate on swatches to meet contrast.

leo: Please ensure new swatches meet WCAG AA for text/labels. Also add aria-describedby to each legend item that includes token counts, and role="list"/role="listitem" where appropriate.

aj: If we show live token counts in the legend, watch rerenders for the chart component. Prefer precomputed counts in the API response and render statically unless user interacts.

maya: Action items: sam — update swatches + produce two mocks (desktop + mobile). aj — prototype grid with DOM order preserved and share a small demo. leo — write a short accessibility checklist for the PR. olivia — compile the support snippets for microcopy.

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mocks/usage-legend-1900456789 (desktop & mobile frames) :tada:

sam: Uploaded Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz123 — please comment on the right-hand legend spacing.

olivia: Microcopy suggestion: standardize on "Download invoice" when action triggers a file download, otherwise "View invoice" for preview. That distinction reduces confusion.

maya: Agreed. We'll standardize copy: "Download invoice" for downloads, "View invoice" for preview. Add to style guide.

aj: I'll add telemetry events: invoice_view, invoice_download, legend_toggle. Also flag if users switch to project scope frequently.

maya: One more UX nit: when toggling Org vs Project scope, chart should animate crossfade rather than jump — helps maintain context. Keep animation subtle.

sam: I'll include animation specs in the mock.

maya: OK wrapping up — I'll put these notes into RD-3421 and assign owners. Schedule a short sync next Tue to review the engineering demo. Thanks!
